summary.content:
Today's selection covers 96 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 64 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: First OpenAI, now Meta - why do AI hacks keep happening?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, Krebs on Security, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 45 articles published in the last 24 hours
